client_credentials.name: OVHcloud EU · Connect with app credentials

config.hint: Use a service account created for the EU API. Send OVH_ACCESS_TOKEN as an Authorization: Bearer token to OVH_API_BASE_URL. The OAuth scope all does not describe IAM permissions; allowed operations and resources are configured in OVHcloud IAM policies. The client ID identifies the configured service account; the account owner's identity and IAM permissions have not been verified. Revoke access by changing the service account's IAM policies or deleting it in OVHcloud.
